fewShots.question: Show the monthly sales
fewShots.query:
SELECT
    YEAR(soh.OrderDate)            AS OrderYear,
    MONTH(soh.OrderDate)           AS OrderMonth,
    DATENAME(MONTH, soh.OrderDate) AS MonthName,
    SUM(soh.SubTotal)              AS MonthlySales
FROM SalesOrderHeader soh
GROUP BY YEAR(soh.OrderDate), MONTH(soh.OrderDate), DATENAME(MONTH, soh.OrderDate)
ORDER BY OrderMonth;

fewShots.question: Who are the top 10 customers by total spend?
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP 10
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName, s.Name) AS CustomerName,
    SUM(soh.SubTotal) AS TotalSpend,
    COUNT(*)          AS Orders
FROM SalesOrderHeader soh
JOIN Customer c     ON soh.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN Person p ON c.PersonID = p.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN Store s   ON c.StoreID = s.BusinessEntityID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, p.FirstName, p.LastName, s.Name
ORDER BY TotalSpend DESC;

fewShots.question: What is estimated product profitability by category?
fewShots.query:
SELECT
    pc.Name AS Category,
    SUM(sod.LineTotal)                 AS Revenue,
    SUM(sod.OrderQty * p.StandardCost) AS EstimatedCost,
    SUM(sod.LineTotal - sod.OrderQty * p.StandardCost) AS EstimatedGrossProfit
FROM SalesOrderDetail sod
JOIN Product p              ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN ProductSubcategory psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = psc.ProductSubcategoryID
JOIN ProductCategory pc     ON psc.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
GROUP BY pc.Name
ORDER BY EstimatedGrossProfit DESC;

fewShots.question: What is the average order value by territory?
fewShots.query:
SELECT
    st.Name AS Territory,
    st.CountryRegionCode,
    SUM(soh.SubTotal) AS TotalSales,
    COUNT(*)          AS OrderCount,
    CAST(SUM(soh.SubTotal) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS AvgOrderValue
FROM SalesOrderHeader soh
JOIN SalesTerritory st ON soh.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID
GROUP BY st.Name, st.CountryRegionCode
ORDER BY AvgOrderValue DESC;

fewShots.question: What are total sales by territory and country?
fewShots.query:
SELECT
    st.Name             AS Territory,
    st.CountryRegionCode,
    SUM(soh.SubTotal)   AS TotalSales
FROM SalesOrderHeader soh
JOIN SalesTerritory st ON soh.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID
GROUP BY st.Name, st.CountryRegionCode
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;

fewShots.question: Compare online vs. offline sales by year.
fewShots.query:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN soh.OnlineOrderFlag = 1 THEN 'Online (Internet)'
         ELSE 'Offline (Reseller / Rep)' END AS Channel,
    YEAR(soh.OrderDate) AS OrderYear,
    SUM(soh.SubTotal)   AS TotalSales,
    COUNT(*)            AS OrderCount
FROM SalesOrderHeader soh
GROUP BY soh.OnlineOrderFlag, YEAR(soh.OrderDate)
ORDER BY OrderYear, Channel;
